title: A uniformly discrete counterexample to bounded approximation in Lipschitz-free spaces

abstractEnglish: We construct a countable uniformly discrete metric space whose real Lipschitz-free space has the approximation property but fails the bounded approximation property, answering Kalton's question negatively. The identity can be approximated on every compact set by finite-rank operators, but no uniform bound on their norms is possible.
